caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spoon positioned diagonally from the bottom left to the upper right of the page. The illustration is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a light beige or off-white background. The spoon has an elongated oval bowl with smooth shading to indicate its curved surface. The handle is straight with a slight taper and expands into a flat, polygonal end. On the wider end of the handle, there is an ornate script monogram composed of the letters "AB" or "AS." The drawing is framed with a simple, thin rectangular border, and the artist’s signature, “E. Schwabe,” is located in the lower right corner just inside the border. There are no additional objects or significant textures present in the image.
title: Silver Spoon
